extracted.intended_audience: prospective authors submitting book-length (and other) work to McSweeney's (writers, authors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and policy information for authors wishing to submit books or other writing to McSweeney's; includes current submission status and policy prohibiting AI-assisted writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission status — currently closed
rubrics_metrics.description: Submissions are currently closed. We don’t have an exact date when they’ll reopen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We’d suggest checking back in a few months. Thank you for considering McSweeney’s.

rubrics_metrics.name: No AI-assisted writing
rubrics_metrics.description: We accept no writing aided in any manner by AI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before publishing any writing—from a letter to a book-length work—authors published at McSweeney’s will be asked to attest that AI played no part in the creation or writing of that work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental/sustainability practice (publisher policy)
rubrics_metrics.description: McSweeney’s is committed to our environment and purchases carbon offsets commensurate with their estimate of the impact of printing, shipping, and travel necessary to publish books and magazines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: They continually work to minimize environmental impact by examining business decisions through a lens of sustainability; contact executive director Amanda Uhle to support this effort or to learn more. (This is a publisher practice statement rather than a stated submission requirement.)
